item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Junior Staff Post
item.content:encoded: Duccy boi, instead of replying to your own comments, please edit your previous post using the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of every comment. That prevents spam buildup, and it's in the rules.

item.title: Re: Corrupted Text
item.content:encoded:
The idea is nice but a bit basic so far and, as said above, have been done before in a similar way. I have some questions that might help give it a more unique spin to it.

Other than being hard to read, what effects this corrupted text has? It spreads so it's akin to a disease, what other symptoms or complications does it cause?
What if it started to affect spoken speech after a while? Maybe even thought process, making the people affected by it to act in a "corrupted" way?

You are still far from the 400 words limit here so you should expand the idea a little more so it will be easier for people to analyse and eventually greenlight it.

item.title: Re: Corrupted Text
item.content:encoded:
How can you use this format screw to make the reader progressively more paranoid as they read that they are perhaps at risk of infohazards reading it?

This is a trope that has also been done quite a bit, I've used it, making edits on the theme for myself right now.

So even then, you have to maybe ground this in a character, perhaps someone from the Media Department who becomes the -A instance of this anomaly.

item.title: Corrupted Text
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional):

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch: An anomaly that latches onto computers and "infects" (putting diacritics on) all text sent by the computer.

Central Narrative: It first affected the small village of Mousehole.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The page itself has the "corrupted" text.

Additional Notes: This is the first idea I thought of myself instead of using a SCP idea generator.
